other_conditions: Must be registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board
Must have become disabled or incapacitated due to an accident while working at a construction site
Must have purchased a lithium‑ion battery‑operated vehicle in his own name
Must hold a tri‑cycle license to operate a tri‑cycle
Benefit is available only once per registered construction disabled worker
benefits_summary: One‑time subsidy of up to 50% of the ex‑showroom price or ₹48,000 (whichever is less), plus reimbursement of registration fee and road tax for the new e‑rickshaw.
